verses.text: For the choir director; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved me in my distress; Be gracious to me and hear my prayer.
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）顯我為義的神啊，我呼籲的時候，求你應允我！我在困苦中，你曾使我寬廣；現在求你憐恤我，聽我的禱告！

verses.text: O sons of men, how long will my honor become a reproach? [How long] will you love what is worthless and aim at deception? Selah.
verses.textZh: 你們這上流人哪，你們將我的尊榮變為羞辱要到幾時呢？你們喜愛虛妄，尋找虛假，要到幾時呢？（細拉）

verses.text: But know that the LORD has set apart the godly man for Himself; The LORD hears when I call to Him.
verses.textZh: 你們要知道，耶和華已經分別虔誠人歸他自己；我求告耶和華，他必聽我。

verses.text: Tremble, and do not sin; Meditate in your heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.textZh: 你們應當畏懼，不可犯罪；在床上的時候，要心裡思想，並要肅靜。（細拉）

verses.text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And trust in the LORD.
verses.textZh: 當獻上公義的祭，又當倚靠耶和華。

verses.text: Many are saying, 'Who will show us [any] good?' Lift up the light of Your countenance upon us, O LORD!
verses.textZh: 有許多人說：誰能指示我們甚麼好處？耶和華啊，求你仰起臉來，光照我們。

verses.text: You have put gladness in my heart, More than when their grain and new wine abound.
verses.textZh: 你使我心裡快樂，勝過那豐收五穀新酒的人。

verses.text: In peace I will both lie down and sleep, For You alone, O LORD, make me to dwell in safety.
verses.textZh: 我必安然躺下睡覺，因為獨有你─耶和華使我安然居住。
